Package bg.tu_varna.ks.models

Class Event

java.lang.Object
bg.tu_varna.ks.models.Event
public class Event extends Object
Domain model for a single event (meeting) in the calendar.

Every event has a unique UUID identifier, a date, start and end time, a name, and an optional note. The class is annotated with JAXB annotations so that it can be automatically serialized to/from an XML file via AppData.

The recommended way to create new instances is to use the nested Event.EventBuilder class (the Builder pattern), which provides readable and orderly initialization code: 


 Event event = new Event.EventBuilder()
         .id(UUID.randomUUID())
         .date(LocalDate.of(2025, 1, 15))
         .start(LocalTime.of(9, 0))
         .end(LocalTime.of(10, 0))
         .name("Team meeting")
         .note("discuss roadmap")
         .build();
